findings.message: Loop condition changed from i < start+len(pageRows) to i <= start+len(pageRows), causing one extra iteration that indexes rows[start+len(pageRows)]. This reads past the page slice and can panic with index out of range (or emit an unintended row when it happens to be in bounds).
findings.suggestion: Revert to i < start+len(pageRows), or iterate over pageRows directly (e.g. for _, row := range pageRows { ... }) instead of indexing rows by computed offset.
